<!-- The below is for the TXGB tab!!!! -->
<script src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.4.1/jquery.min.js"></script>
<script> 
function createTab(tabLabel) {
	var topMenuBar = $("#ctl16_NavItems");
	
	var topMobileMenuBar = $("#top-nav");
	
	var totalNumberOfTabsLive = topMenuBar.children().length;
	
	var newTotalNumberOfTabsLive = totalNumberOfTabsLive + 1;
	
	var deskTab = document.createElement("LI");
	var mobTab = document.createElement("LI");
	var mobTabSpriteSpan = document.createElement("SPAN");
	var mobTabSprite = document.createElement("DIV");
	var tabLinkInternals = document.createElement("A");
	var tabLinkMobInternals = document.createElement("A");
	
	deskTab.setAttribute("id","ctl16_NavigationRepeater_ctl05_Li");
	deskTab.setAttribute("class","top-nav nav-theatre has-dropdown txgb");
	deskTab.setAttribute("data-cattype","nav-theatre");
	deskTab.setAttribute("style","width: calc(100% / "+newTotalNumberOfTabsLive+");border-right: 1px solid #e1e0e0;");
	
	mobTab.setAttribute("id","ctl16_NavigationRepeater_ctl05_Li");
	mobTab.setAttribute("class","top-nav nav-theatre has-dropdown txgb");
	mobTab.setAttribute("data-cattype","nav-theatre");
	
	mobTabSpriteSpan.setAttribute("class","icon");
	
	mobTabSprite.setAttribute("class","sprite");
	
	tabLinkInternals.setAttribute("id","ctl16_NavigationRepeater_ctl05_ItemHyperLink");
	tabLinkInternals.setAttribute("class","nav");
	tabLinkInternals.setAttribute("href", "http://itinerary.visitbritainshop.com/?utm_source=Visit_Britain_Shop&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=English_Shop"); //Change link here for destination website
	tabLinkInternals.setAttribute("style","padding: 0; text-align: center;")
	tabLinkInternals.innerHTML = tabLabel;
	
	tabLinkMobInternals.setAttribute("id","ctl16_NavigationRepeater_ctl05_ItemHyperLink");
	tabLinkMobInternals.setAttribute("class","nav");
	tabLinkMobInternals.setAttribute("href", "http://itinerary.visitbritainshop.com/?utm_source=Visit_Britain_Shop&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=English_Shop"); //Change link here for destination website
	tabLinkMobInternals.innerHTML = tabLabel;
	
	deskTab.append(tabLinkInternals);
	mobTab.append(tabLinkMobInternals);
	mobTabSpriteSpan.append(mobTabSprite);
	mobTab.append(mobTabSpriteSpan);
	
	for(i=0;i < totalNumberOfTabsLive;i++){
		topMenuBar.children()[i].setAttribute("style","width: calc(100% / "+newTotalNumberOfTabsLive+"); border-right: 1px solid #e1e0e0;");
		topMenuBar.children()[i].firstElementChild.setAttribute("style","padding: 0; text-align: center;")
	}
	
	
	topMenuBar.append(deskTab);
	topMobileMenuBar.append(mobTab);
}

$(document).ready(function() {

	createTab("More Attractions & Experiences"); //Enter name and destination of tab
	
	window.bigTopMessage = "You are now leaving the VisitBritain Shop."; //change this to the (language if needed) version of text you need. This is the sentence at the very top of the popup.
	
	window.firstSmallMessage = "You will be taken to our partners website."; //Change this to whatever you'd like to appear on the first sentence of the pop up (non-bold).
	
	window.secondBoldMessage = "Please note that any items in your basket will not be carried over."; //Change this to what you would like to appear as the bold sentence.
	
	window.doYouWishToCont = "Do you wish to continue?"; //This is the message just before the buttons to ask the ysed if they'd like to continue.
	
	window.continueButton = "Continue"; //This is the text for the continue button.
	
	window.cancelButton = "Cancel"; //This is the text for the cancel button.
	
    window.goAway=function() {
        $("#cover").remove(), $("#popup").remove()
    }
    var t = $(".txgb a").attr("href");
    $(".txgb a").attr("href", "#"), $(".txgb a").attr("onclick", "pATV(); return false;"), window.pATV=function() {
        $("body").prepend('<div id="cover" onClick="goAway()"></div><div id="popup"><h2 id="popuptext">'+bigTopMessage+'</h2><p id="popuptext2">'+firstSmallMessage+'</p><p id="popuptext2bolder">'+secondBoldMessage+'</p><p id="yestext">'+doYouWishToCont+'</p><a id="linktogo" href="'+t+'"><button id="ok">'+continueButton+'</button></a><button id="cancel" onClick="goAway()">'+cancelButton+'</button><img id="logo" src="http://visitbritainshop.com/world/~/media/99f15222acfa4cc4a6f4698fd92274f5.ashx"></div>')
    }
});

</script>
<style> 
#mobile-nav ul li {
    margin-left: 0;
    padding-left: 0;
    width: calc(100%)!important;
    border-right: none!important
}

#mobile-nav li a {
    padding: 24px 50px 12px 0!important;
    text-align: unset!important
}

#cover {
    position: absolute;
    display: block;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background-color: #000;
    opacity: .2;
    z-index: 6
}

#popup {
    position: fixed;
    background-color: #fff;
    display: block;
    margin-top: 300px;
    margin-left: calc(50% - (500px/2));
    width: 500px;
    opacity: 1;
    border: 2px solid #d9d9d9;
    z-index: 9999
}

#popuptext {
    display: block;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 33px;
    margin-bottom: 30px
}

#popuptext2 {
    font-size: 16px;
    margin-top: -30px;
    padding: 10px;
    text-align: center;
}

#popuptext2bolder{
	font-size: 16px;
    margin-top: -30px;
    padding: 10px;
    text-align: center;
	font-weight: bold;
}

#logo {
    margin-top: -8px;
    margin-left: -229px;
    width: 65px;
    float: left;
    height: 65px
}

#ok {
    display: block;
    margin-left: 118px;
    margin-right: auto;
    margin-top: 1px;
    width: 120px;
    font-weight: 400;
    float: left
}

#cancel {
    float: right;
    display: block;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: 118px;
    margin-top: 1px;
    width: 120px;
    font-weight: 400
}

#yestext {
    font-weight: 700;
    display: block;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 14px
}

@media screen and (max-width:550px) {
    #popup {
        margin-left: calc(50% - (300px / 2));
        width: 300px;
        margin-top: 144px
    }
    #popuptext {
        font-size: 25px
    }
    #ok {
        margin-left: 25px
    }
    #cancel {
        margin-right: 25px
    }
    #logo {
        display: none
    }
}

</style>

//This is a banner carosuel for the front page that changes every n seconds.

var arrayOfImages = [
"https://www.visitbritainshop.com/world//world/~/media/images/banners/halloween 2019/halloween2019_promo_eng.ashx",  //1
"https://www.visitbritainshop.com/world//world/~/media/images/banners/london eye api/londoneyeapi_promo_eng.ashx",  //2
"https://www.visitbritainshop.com/world//world/~/media/images/banners/london dungeon api/londondungeonapi_promo_eng.ashx"]; //3

//This is for all the links that the banners go to; its the same order as the banner (first link for first banner etc).
var arrayOfLinks = [
"https://www.visitbritainshop.com/world/attractions/halloween-attractions=c/#filter-area",                         //1
"https://www.visitbritainshop.com/world/london-eye-ticket/",                       //2
"https://www.visitbritainshop.com/world/london-dungeon-tickets/"];  //3

//This is for each alt tag for each image; its the same order as the banner (first link for first banner etc).
var arrayOfAltTags = [
"Halloween2019_promo_HP_ENG",   //1
"LondonEyeAPI_promo_HP_ENG",      //2
"londonDungeonAPI_promo_HP_ENG"];    //3

//This is the number of seconds before the banner should automatically change.
var seconds = 7;

//END OF CONFIGURATION (please do not edit anything below)

</script>
<style>
.bannerCarosuelBody{
	z-index: 0;
	width: 100%;
	margin-left: auto;
	margin-right: auto;
	display: block;
}
.shownBanner{
	font-family: sans-serif;
    z-index: 1;
    float: left;
    width: 100%;
    background-color: white;
}
*.unselectable {
   -moz-user-select: -moz-none;
   -khtml-user-select: none;
   -webkit-user-select: none;
   -ms-user-select: none;
   user-select: none;
}
</style>
<div class="bannerCarosuelBody">
<div class="product-carousel__prev slick-arrow" onclick="move(-1);" style="display: block;" tabindex="0"></div>
<a class="changeableHref" href="https://www.visitbritainshop.com/world/attractions/halloween-attractions=c/#filter-area">
<img alt="Halloween2019_promo_HP_ENG" class="shownBanner unselectable" href="#" src="https://www.visitbritainshop.com/world//world/~/media/images/banners/halloween 2019/halloween2019_promo_eng.ashx" style="opacity: 1;"/>
</a>
<div class="product-carousel__next slick-arrow" onclick="move(+1);" style="display: block;" tabindex="0"></div>
</div>
<div style="font-size: 20px; margin-bottom: 16px; text-align:center">
<span class="dot" onclick="immediateChange(0)" style="color: rgb(3, 66, 142);">⚫</span>
<span class="dot" onclick="immediateChange(1)" style="color: rgba(3, 66, 142, 0.49);">⚫</span>
<span class="dot" onclick="immediateChange(2)" style="color: rgba(3, 66, 142, 0.49);">⚫</span>
</div>
<script src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.4.0/jquery.min.js"></script>
<script>
	var currentIndex = 0;
	
	var dots = $(".dot");
		
	update();	
	
		
	var switcher = setInterval(function(){move(1);}, 7000);
	
	function move(n){
		currentIndex += n;
		clearInterval(switcher);
		switcher = setInterval(function(){move(1);}, 7000);
		update();
	}
	
	function immediateChange(n){
		dotsUpdate(n);
		currentIndex = n;
		clearInterval(switcher);
		switcher = setInterval(function(){move(1);}, 7000);
		update();
	}
	
	function dotsUpdate(n){
		if(n == 0){
			dots[0].style.color = "#03428e";
			dots[1].style.color = "#03428e7d";
			dots[2].style.color = "#03428e7d";
		}else if(n == 1){
			dots[0].style.color = "#03428e7d";
			dots[1].style.color = "#03428e";
			dots[2].style.color = "#03428e7d";
		}else if(n == 2){
			dots[0].style.color = "#03428e7d";
			dots[1].style.color = "#03428e7d";
			dots[2].style.color = "#03428e";
		}
	}
	
	function imgUpdate(srcn){
		$(".shownBanner").animate({"opacity": 0}, "fast");
		setTimeout(function(){
			$(".shownBanner").attr("src",""+arrayOfImages[srcn]+"")
			$(".changeableHref").attr("href",""+arrayOfLinks[srcn]+"")
			$(".shownBanner").attr("alt",""+arrayOfAltTags[srcn]+"")
		},200);
		$(".shownBanner").animate({"opacity": 1}, "fast");
	}
	
	function update(){
		if(currentIndex == 3){
			currentIndex = 0;
		}else if(currentIndex == -1){
			currentIndex = 2;
		}
		imgUpdate(currentIndex);
		dotsUpdate(currentIndex);
	}
</script>
</div>
</div>
</div>
